policy: Only CC0 / CC-BY / similarly permissive data may train a shipped model. Share-alike, non-commercial, research-only, no-derivatives and unlicensed data are not accepted. 'verified_on' is the date the licence page was fetched and read for this manifest; a status of 'unverified' means the licence could not be established from a fetched page and the source is blocked.
decision: Adrian 2026-10-17: train our own NAFNet width16 on publicly available data; no Megvii correspondence and no Megvii weights (issue #200).

sources.name: Ember corpus: CC0 raw samples from raw.pixls.us (cargo run -p xtask -- corpus --download)
sources.evidence: raw.pixls.us upload form: 'I hereby release it under the CC0 licence into the public domain'; the licence link is titled 'Creative Commons Zero - Public Domain Dedication'. The site also lists non-CC0 samples; only the files pinned (URL + SHA-256) in xtask/src/main.rs RAW_SAMPLES are used, each recorded there as CC0.
sources.use: clean source (train / val / held-out by content hash)
sources.notes: Small and many cameras but few scenes; Bayer only (X-Trans and linear DNG skipped); sources recorded above ISO 800 are skipped as not clean. Keep one frame per scene so a burst cannot straddle splits.

sources.name: MIT-Adobe FiveK (5,000 raw DNGs)
sources.evidence: Both licence files grant rights 'solely for your own research purposes' and forbid exercising them 'in any manner that is intended for or directed toward commercial advantage'. Second file: https://data.csail.mit.edu/graphics/fivek/legal/LicenseAdobeMIT.txt (same research-only grant). The licence applies to derivative use, so a shipped model is excluded.

sources.name: RAISE (8,156 raw images)
sources.licence: non-commercial research and educational use only
sources.evidence: Download page: 'The RAISE dataset is to be used for non-commercial research and educational purposes.' No grant for commercial use or for shipped models.

sources.name: PPR10K (portrait photo retouching pairs)
sources.evidence: README agreement: 'All files in the PPR10K dataset are available for non-commercial research purposes only.' and no reproduction or exploitation for commercial purposes. Only the code is Apache-2.0. It is also a retouching dataset, not a noise one.

sources.name: SIDD (smartphone raw noisy/clean pairs and noise-level functions)
sources.licence: MIT (stated on the project page only)
sources.evidence: Project page: 'The dataset and the associated code repositories are under the MIT License.' No LICENSE file or per-image grant was seen, and the page does not address commercial use. Five small smartphone sensors only; ground truth is a burst average, not a base-ISO capture.
sources.use: none until verified; possible calibration reference only (its per-image noise level functions are the only public per-sensor (a, b) data found)
sources.notes: Not accepted. Read the dataset repository's LICENSE file before any use, including calibration.

sources.name: Natural Image Noise Dataset (NIND), Wikimedia Commons
sources.evidence: The Commons page says files are available under licences on their description pages and names no dataset licence. Per its download script the images are 8-bit JPG / 16-bit PNG, i.e. already developed, not raw mosaics.
sources.use: none: not a raw mosaic, so unusable for this pipeline; at most a real-noise eval set after per-file licences are read

sources.name: Raw Natural Image Noise Dataset (rawNIND), UCLouvain Dataverse
sources.licence: unknown (the Dataverse landing page did not render its licence field)
sources.evidence: The landing page fetched with title only; no licence text was obtained. The paper (arXiv 2501.08924) describes it as paired noisy/clean raws from several sensors. Issue #200's survey found the rawNIND CODE is GPL-3.0; that says nothing about the data.
sources.use: none until the Dataverse licence field is read; a real-noise raw eval and noise-prior calibration set if it is CC0 / CC-BY
sources.notes: Not accepted. Best candidate to calibrate the (a, b) prior on real high-ISO raws.

sources.name: Raw files uploaded to Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence: per file; Commons allows CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA and PD
sources.evidence: Commons:Licensing: licensing is per file, NC and ND are not accepted, and CC-BY-SA is accepted, so a Commons file is only usable here if its own description page shows CC0 or CC-BY (never -SA). No category listing raw camera files could be fetched.
sources.use: none until individual files are read and added as their own accepted entries with file URL, licence and attribution
sources.notes: Not accepted as a bulk source. CC-BY files would need attribution carried into the model card.
